_doc: Ground truth for each fixture. Keys are fixture ids (category/name). 'expected' lists the canonical vuln classes that SHOULD be found in that fixture; an empty list means the fixture is clean and ANY finding is a false positive. 'files' is informational.

vulnerable/path_traversal.note: LFI via unsanitized os.path.join in read_doc

vulnerable/ssrf_fetch.note: user URL fetched server-side, no allowlist

vulnerable/idor_invoice.note: invoice fetched by user id with no ownership check

mixed/user_api.note: command injection in run_lookup; get_profile is safe and must not be flagged
